scope: All 22 mapped Clos des Lambrays parcels and 3 recorded legal-entity identifiers reviewed for Tier 1, including commune edges, cadastral named areas and the #461 historical extension. Both notice-index candidates were read from their page images; they are two publications of one application, which becomes one event on seven current parcels. Producer/company research remains Tier 2. No current farmer is verified.

sources.finding: The receipt (dossier 2021-061, act BFC-2021-04-09-00018) prints Morey-Saint-Denis AP0101, AP0102, AP0105, AP0106, AP0107, AP0108 and AP0199 among 23 Morey references, separately from Puligny-Montrachet, Flagey-Echezeaux and Nuits-Saint-Georges. 13.2473 ha across all four communes, previous operator SCEA Les Beaux Monts; filed 15 March 2021, complete 7 April 2021.
